extensions.name: Timer
extensions.description: Countdown timers from the palette: `timer 10m tea` notifies you when the tea is ready
extensions.author: Arseniy Zarechnev

extensions.name: Calpad
extensions.description: Quick Calpad sessions: `price = 10`, `$120 - 30%` or `now + 90 days` opens a live calculator note; Ctrl+O continues it in the Calpad desktop app
extensions.author: Arseniy Zarechnev

extensions.name: Keyboard Cleaner
extensions.description: Block the keyboard and pointer for a chosen duration so the keyboard can be wiped without triggering keys: `wipe 5m` or `block 30s` opens the cleaning window
extensions.author: ozz1ee
